digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, evidence contract, attested evidence validation
propositions: Gates miss defects when measurement context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) is not recorded in the evidence, allowing unobservable measurements to pass validation
Four-field measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) must be deterministically enforced in [operator-attested] evidence prior to LLM evaluation

Privilege-masked observations (live calls under wildcard identity, policy simulators answering wrong questions) cannot distinguish whether an evidence failure is structural or incidental, rendering their success uninformative
Plan-review gates cannot re-run world measurements to validate provenance without recursively encountering the same privilege-masking problem in the verifier itself
Citation discipline (requiring plans to cite the resolution paths that implement their claimed invariants) is a complementary gap independent of provenance capture
